alt: Close-up before photo at a gable peak: a gloved hand points to an open gap where the painted fascia trim and J-channel meet above vinyl siding
Looking down a gray asphalt shingle roof at a long strip of wind-torn, missing shingles beside the exposed area during inspection
Standing water across a flat EPDM roof after rain, with twigs and leaf debris pinned in the ponding and an inspector’s boot at the water’s edge for scale
Crew tearing off a commercial low-slope roof, with the old EPDM membrane peeled back over water-stained recovery board and rotted layers exposed beside new parapet framing
Full strip of aged three-tab asphalt shingle laid on a concrete walkway after removal from the roof, showing heavy granule loss, a worn seam line, and torn spots along one edge
Drone view of the crew stripping two layers of shingles down to plank decking on a two-story hip roof
Overhead drone view of a gray shingle roof with seven new low-profile vents and turbines installed, large fenced backyard below
Extension ladder reaching a third-story gable while a technician re-secures a piece of vinyl siding at the top
Three extension ladders set against the tall gable while a crew member installs new vinyl siding over fresh house wrap
Drone view at eave height of the brick ranch before work, its old dark three-tab roof weathered and streaked
Wind-stripped low-slope roof section with the mineral-surfaced roll roofing peeled back in a large ragged sheet
The top course of vinyl siding missing along the run at the head of a two-story wall, leaving the cavity open
